q: Bowen's definition of topological entropy uses (n,ε)-separated sets. The entropy is:
opts: h_top(f) = lim_{n→∞}(1/n)log s_n(ε) for any ε>0
exp: Bowen: h_top = lim_{ε→0} limsup_{n→∞}(1/n)log sₙ(ε). One first takes n→∞ then ε→0 (so we're capturing the exponential growth rate of distinguishable orbits at any resolution). The order of limits matters.
